name: Grafana Cloud
description: Grafana's hosted server for Grafana Cloud stacks: dashboards, Prometheus and Loki queries, alerts and incidents. Public preview; use counts toward Grafana Assistant usage.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.grafana.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
